test_title: PYST 34: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the appropriate synonym for the underlined word.**

I didn't have time to give them **__proof__**.
solution:
The correct answer is "evidence."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "proof" means information, documents, etc. which show that something is true. (किसी बात को सत्‍य सिद्घ करने वाली जानकारी, दस्‍तावेज़ आदि; प्रमाण, सबूत))

 
 
• Example: *‘We need some **proof**__ of identity,’ the shop assistant said.*
 
 
 
• The word "proof" is a synonym of "evidence."
 
• The word "evidence" means the facts, signs, etc. that make you believe that something is true. (सबूत, साक्ष्‍य, गवाही)
 __
 
• Example:* There was not enough **evidence**__ to prove him guilty.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Guess: **an effort you make to imagine a possible answer or give an opinion when you cannot be sure if you are right. (सही होने के निश्‍चय के बिना संभावित उत्तर की कल्‍पना या अपनी सम्‍मति देने का प्रयास, (किसी बात का) अंदाज़ा, अनुमान)
 
• **Snap: **a sudden sharp sound of something breaking. (किसी वस्‍तु के एकाएक टूटने से उत्‍पन्‍न तेज़ आवाज़; चिटक, चिटका, तड़क)
 
• **Charge: **the price that you must pay for goods or services. (ख़रीदी गई वस्‍तु या सेवा पर शुल्‍क, ख़र्च, व्‍यय)
